s1.title: Gwada Haddar Ku
s1.body: Manhaja da ke gwada haddar Alqur'ani naku ta hanyar tambayoyin zaɓi da yawa, kuma tana ba ku damar yin gasa da masu haddar Alqur'ani a duniya baki ɗaya.
s1.p1: Tambayoyin da aka daidaita da iyakar haddar ku
s1.p2: Ƙalubalen yau da kullum mai ƙayyadadden lokaci
s1.p3: Matsayi a jerin manyan na duniya

s2.title: Yadda Take Aiki
s2.body: Wani yanki na aya zai bayyana, sai ku zaɓi kalmar da ta dace daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka biyar. Kowace amsa daidai tana ƙara maki, idan kuma kun yi kuskure, muna nuna muku ayar gaba ɗaya da matsayinta a cikin Alqur'ani.

s3.title: Ƙalubalen Yau da Kullum
s3.body: Sabbin tambayoyi 10 kowace rana a cikin iyakar haddar ku, da ƙayyadadden lokaci. Ku amsa da sauri kuma daidai domin samun mafi yawan maki kafin lokaci ya ƙare.

s4.title: Zama na Farko a Jerin Manyan
s4.body: Kwatanta makinku da na masu haddar Alqur'ani a duniya a jerin manyan — na yau da kullum da na tsawon lokaci. Tara maki ku ci gaba gaba a matsayi.

intro.title: Gabatarwa
intro.body: A Quran Quiz Net, muna daraja sirrinku. Wannan shafi yana bayyana irin bayanan da muke tattarawa, yadda muke amfani da su, da yadda muke kiyaye su lokacin da kuke amfani da manhajar.

dataCollected.title: Bayanan da Muke Tattarawa
dataCollected.body: Idan kuka shiga da Google ko Facebook, muna adana sunanku, hoton bayaninku, da adireshin imel domin ƙirƙirar bayaninku. Muna kuma adana ci gaban haddarku, sakamakon jarrabawa, da saitunanku. Hakanan za ku iya amfani da manhajar a matsayin baƙo ba tare da shiga ba.

useOfData.title: Yadda Muke Amfani da Bayananku
useOfData.body: Muna amfani da bayananku domin adanawa da daidaita ci gabanku a cikin na'urorinku, nuna matsayinku a jerin manyan da ƙalubalen yau da kullum, da inganta gogewarku a cikin manhajar. Ba mu sayar da bayananku ko nuna talla.

cookiesAnalytics.title: Cookies & Bincike
cookiesAnalytics.body: Muna amfani da Google Analytics domin fahimtar yadda ake amfani da manhajar (kamar shafukan da aka ziyarta da yawan jarrabawa) domin inganta gogewar mai amfani, ta hanyar cookies. Muna kunna wannan bibiya ne kawai da izininku, kuma za ku iya ƙin yarda daga bagen izini ba tare da shafar amfaninku da manhajar ba. Muna amfani da wannan bayanan ne kawai domin bincike, ba domin talla ba.

storageSecurity.title: Ajiya & Tsaro
storageSecurity.body: Ana ajiye bayananku a sabobin Firebase na Google tare da kariya ta dace. Bayananku na cikin na'ura suna nan a na'urarku kuma ana share su lokacin da kuka fita.

accountDeletion.title: Share Asusu
accountDeletion.body: Za ku iya fita a kowane lokaci domin share bayananku na cikin na'ura daga wannan na'urar. Domin share asusunku da duk bayananku daga sabobinmu har abada da kanku: daga babban shafi, danna alamar saituna ⚙ a saman shafin, sannan ku danna "Share Asusu" a ƙasan shafin Saitunan, sannan ku tabbatar da sharewa. Za a share asusunku nan take, kuma ba za a iya soke wannan aikin ba.

termsOfUse.title: Sharuɗɗan Amfani
termsOfUse.body: An tsara manhajar domin taimaka muku sake duba haddarku na Alƙur'ani mai girma. Ana bayar da hidimar "kamar yadda take" ba tare da wata garantin ba, kuma muna ƙoƙarin tabbatar da daidaiton abin da ke cikin Alƙur'ani bisa tushen Tanzil (tanzil.net).

contact.title: Tuntuɓa
contact.body: Domin duk wata tambaya game da sirri ko sharuɗɗa, za ku iya tuntuɓarmu ta hanyar imel na hukuma na manhajar.

technical.title: Tallafin Fasaha
technical.body: Kun ci karo da matsala tare da manhajar, ko kuna da shawara don inganta ta? Muna farin cikin taimakawa. Ku aiko mana da imel a ƙasa kuma za mu amsa muku da wuri-wuri.

sync.title: Matsalolin Shiga ko Daidaitawa
sync.body: Idan kuna fuskantar matsala wajen shiga da Google ko Facebook, ko kuka lura cewa ci gabanku ba ya daidaitawa a cikin na'urorinku, ku tuntuɓe mu tare da ambaton irin na'urarku da tsarin aikinta domin mu taimaka muku da sauri.

deletion.title: Share Asusu ko Bayanai
deletion.body: Domin neman a share asusunku da bayananku da aka ajiye a sabobinmu har abada, ku aiko mana da imel a ƙasa kuma za mu kammala buƙatar cikin 'yan kwanaki.
